Class CashierApp.TicketLine

java.lang.Object
frontend.CashierApp.TicketLine
Enclosing class:
CashierApp
static class CashierApp.TicketLine extends Object
A ticket line either represents a combo or an a-la-carte selection. It maintains lists of picked menu items and can compute the line total.
